en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We ran to the entrance hall, trying to
escape the battle that was unfolding.
Th-Things have suddenly become really bad...

So the robot uprising finally happened...
It's what I always feared, but...
I-I never expected it'd be like this!

But why did Monokuma leave a weapon like
that in the research lab?
He's...pretty careless, isn't he?
Eeeeek! I-I'm not scared! I'm not scared!
Hey, what should we do?

...Just as I said before. We need to find
the truth in order to end this killing game.
Okay, but...what do we need to look for?

...Obviously, we need to find the real identity
of the mastermind behind the killing game.

The mastermind...? Is there really a 
mastermind in this academy?

If the outside world is destroyed, then the
mastermind must be in this school, right?

Kokichi wasn't the mastermind...
Then, in that case...

But I thought the only ones saved by 
the Gofer Project were us 16 students...

Don't you think it's possible <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone<CLT=typeNORMAL> may
have infiltrated the Gofer Project?

That someone could be the mastermind,
hiding somewhere in this school.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Someone<CLT=typeNORMAL>... You mean a 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>, right?

Then someone else inside this academy 
besides Kokichi is a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>?

If we can find them and kill them, then this
killing game should end.
Ah, I don't know about *killing* them...

But there is the possibility that the mastermind
is hiding somewhere in this academy.

This complex is huge, there must be
places we haven't explored yet.
It seems like it's worth a shot.

And that's not the only thing
we have to find...

To truly end this killing game, we must
find this mastermind of <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
and also find <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...Hope?

Our home. Where we're going to
live after this killing game ends.

I know there is <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL> out there.
We have to find it before we leave.

This isn't some fictional story, so I don't
think things'll work out that well...

But if we look for it, we just might find it.
If we don't try...we'll never find anything.
So we have to try.

Since Keebo is distracting the Exisals, we won't
have to worry about violating school rules...

There must be other rooms that we haven't
investigated yet.

You're right... There's no point complaining.
Let's all just do what we can.

W-Well...if we all work together, 
everything will be all right...right?
Yeah...it shouldn't be difficult.

No matter how impossible it seems, we'll
accomplish it.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki...
...Yes...that's right!

<CLT=cltMIND>We need to find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltMIND>
hidden in this academy...

<CLT=cltMIND>When all is revealed...
this killing game will end!
Then, let's split up and start searching.

Nyeh!? We're gonna split up?
But we were just in such a united mood.

Well...we don't have enough time left 
to all go together, unfortunately.
Right...we'll see each other soon.

Alright, I should go too. We need to
end this killing game before dawn—
Aaugh!
Wh-What? A...hole...?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Now it is time to test your <CLT=cltSTRONG>bonds<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
with your friends!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The time to dawn and your <CLT=cltSTRONG>bond<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with
your friends will be displayed.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If your <CLT=cltSTRONG>bond<CLT=cltSYSTEM> increases,
you can move large debris.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>So work hard to end this killing game
before dawn breaks!

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a staircase...
Why is there a staircase here?

<CLT=cltMIND>Was this staircase...supposed to be unlocked
by a <CLT=cltSTRONG>mysterious item<CLT=cltMIND>?

There must be clues here...
I have to investigate!
